parties: TTK Prestige Limited; Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited (51% subsidiary)
headline: TTK Prestige to divest 51% stake in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions
sum: TTK Prestige Limited announced an agreement for the sale of its 51% stake in Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited, signalling a strategic divestment of the modular kitchen solutions subsidiary.
implication: Subsidiary sale-down to below 50% ownership triggers loss-of-control accounting treatment and potential regulatory disclosures under CCI and SEBI rules; divestment of consumer-facing modular solutions marks a portfolio simplification in the kitchenware/durables sector.
detail: TTK Prestige, a market-leading manufacturer of kitchen appliances and cookware, executed an agreement for the sale of a controlling 51% stake in its subsidiary Ultrafresh Modular Solutions Limited (which operates in modular kitchen cabinetry and solutions). The transaction moves TTK Prestige from a 51% subsidiary structure to minority/associate status, triggering statutory accounting reclassification and potential fiduciary/governance notifications to shareholders and exchanges. The sale price and buyer identity were not disclosed in the NSE filing.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Regulation 30
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of material events; sale of subsidiary stake is a listed-entity disclosure trigger.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 – Section 130 (subsidiary accounting and control loss)
framework.note: Loss of control of subsidiary below 50% requires reclassification as associate/JV in consolidated accounts.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 – Regulation 3 & 4
framework.note: If buyer acquires >25% or crosses 51%, takeover/open offer rules may apply; depends on buyer identity and post-transaction shareholding.
CCI review may be required if buyer qualifies as 'enterprise' and combined turnover exceeds threshold for change-of-control transactions.
Tax-free rollover or capital gains treatment depends on whether buyer is a related party or arm's-length third party.

framework.ref: TTK Prestige Limited Articles of Association
framework.note: Board approval and shareholder approval (if material related-party transaction) may be required under company constitution.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018
framework.note: If consideration involves securities or equity, valuation and fairness opinion requirements apply.

conditions: Completion of statutory audits and financial statements certification
approvals: Potential CCI review (change of control in subsidiary)
